chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from al-Qasim from Aban from Mansur ibn Hazim said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the waiting period (istibra') of a female slave who has not yet reached menstruation, while he feared for her, and he said: 'Five and forty nights.'
ai.seo_question: What is the istibra period for a young female slave who has not yet menstruated?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Istibsar clarifies the istibra' (waiting period) for a pre-pubescent female slave, establishing forty-five nights as the definitive period to ascertain pregnancy when her age is unknown. This ruling highlights the Shia juristic approach to resolving uncertainty in manumission and marriage eligibility by setting a fixed temporal benchmark rather than relying solely on physical signs. It underscores the practical application of prophetic tradition in managing the legal status of slaves within the early Islamic community.
